#.label: Card payments (preview)
#/properties/connector.label: Card payment provider
#/properties/connector.description: Who takes card payments from a checkout through Hii Connect. A checkout uses one provider at a time. A value set higher up applies to every checkout below it unless a checkout has its own. NONE: no provider. ADYEN_CLOUD: Adyen terminals through Adyen's cloud. NETS_CLOUD: Nets (Nexi). SOFTPAY: Softpay tap to pay. VIVA: Viva. WIPAY: Worldline WIPay. WOTAPI: Worldline Terminal API. Adyen local is chosen on the tender.
